title: Host restart mid-step -> failed host-interrupted; a durably suspended run survives
rule: specs/aip-58.mdx section 2 State machine -- host restart

scenarios.label: A -- plain running run, no suspend record

notes: No prior suspend record existed for this run, so it is not eligible for the durable-suspend carve-out -- it is marked failed on reload.
The run's durable suspend record survives the restart untouched -- no run.failed event is emitted, and the run stays exactly as it was.

A subsequent run.resume against the re-registered pending entry still resolves. This MUST hold regardless of which step kind (kind: "approval" or kind: "suspend") produced the suspension -- AIP-15 rule 7, as amended 2026-09-25, requires durable persistence for both identically; the reference runner already persists and re-registers both (awaitingApproval / awaitingSuspend).
